input: Could you provide detailed information on Clark Safari's daily operating hours, holiday opening schedule, and how the entry cut-off time influences the duration of a visit?
expected_output:
Clark Safari and Adventure Park operates daily from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, including holidays, ensuring visitors can enjoy the park any day of the year. However, the entry cut-off time is set at 4:00 PM, which means guests must enter the park by this time to have sufficient opportunity to explore the attractions and exhibits (Clark Safari Operating Hours and Holiday Schedule).

The 4:00 PM cut-off effectively limits the maximum duration of a visit to about 2 hours if entering at the last allowed time, as the park closes at 6:00 PM. Visitors entering earlier in the day can enjoy a longer visit, up to 10 hours. This policy helps manage visitor flow and ensures guests have ample time to experience the park safely and comfortably (Entry Cut-off Time).

In summary, Clark Safari is open every day from 8 AM to 6 PM, including holidays, with a strict 4 PM entry cut-off to optimize visitor experience and park operations.

Open Holidays?
We are open daily from 8AM - 6PM including holidays. Our entry cut-off time
is 4PM. See below our updated rates:
Adult - P599
Child (4ft & below) - P499
FREE entrance for children 2ft & below
What is your upcoming event on December? Stay tuned for upcoming events through our official social media channels!
Is Zoobic safari and Clark safari are the same?
No, Zoobic Safari and Clark Safari are not the same.
1. Zoobic Safari:
Located in Subic Bay Freeport Zone, Zambales.
Known for its "close encounter" experiences, such as feeding tigers and
other exotic animals.
2. Clark Safari:
Located in Clark Freeport Zone, Pampanga.
A newer attraction compared to Zoobic Safari, offering a variety of animals,
adventure activities like ATV rides, and family-friendly facilities.
how much is vehicle rental in clark safari?
For our rental service, we call it the TRAM Ride. You can enjoy the whole
park for a fixed price of ₱4,500. This price is applicable regardless of the
number of people, as long as the maximum capacity is 10 passengers.
What about solo parent? About the solo parent promo: It is a regular paying rate, priced at 599 pesos.
Cav i inquire about Group Tour?
Yes, you can! Could you provide more details about your group tour? Email
us at clarksafari.mktg@gmail.com or call us Viber 09357080918, Onsite you
can look Ms. Sheena or Sir Jm to assist. updated number
Can i bring own car inside the park?
No, personal vehicles are not allowed inside the park. Guests can park in the
designated areas and explore the park on foot or use the park's
transportation services. This helps keep the park safe and enjoyable for
everyone.
Activity is excluded to entrance fee?
Yes, the activity is exclusive to our admission fee, meaning it is not included
in the standard entry ticket. Guests who wish to participate in the activity will
need to pay an additional fee. However, this is entirely optional, and they can
choose whether or not to take part in the activity based on their preferences.
Free meal?
No, free meals are not included with admission. However, we have Banua
Restaurant inside the zoo, where you can enjoy a variety of delicious meals.
Banua Restaurant specializes in authentic Kapampangan cuisine, offering a
range of flavorful dishes to enhance your visit.
Do you have night tour?
No, we currently do not offer night tours. Our operating hours are designed
to ensure the safety and comfort of our guests and animals, and all activities
take place during the day.
Do you have girrafe and elephant?
Currently, we do not have giraffes or elephants in the zoo. However, we are
planning to include them in the future, so stay tuned for updates! In the
meantime, we have a wide variety of fascinating animals for you to enjoy,
including big cats, reptiles, small cats, mammals, and many others. There’s
plenty to explore and discover during your visit!

Government discount?
Thank you for your inquiry. At the moment, we do not offer any government

input: Could you please explain the policies regarding toddler food allowances compared to general outside food bans, specifically in relation to ensuring animal safety inside the facility?
expected_output: Toddler food and milk, including toddler milk, are allowed inside Clark Safari provided they are in child-safe containers. This exception is made to accommodate the needs of young children. However, outside food and drinks for older children and adults are strictly prohibited to ensure the safety and well-being of the animals, as bringing outside food could pose risks to them. This policy helps maintain a controlled environment that protects the animals from potential harm caused by unauthorized food items (Context).

No, picnics are not allowed inside the zoo, as bringing outside food and
drinks is prohibited to ensure the safety and well-being of our animals.

our onsite dining options, such as Banua Restaurant, which offers delicious
meals for your convenience.

several hotels and lodging options located nearby where you can book your

For toddlers, you are welcome to bring their food and milk, including toddler

for older children and adults are not permitted to help maintain the safety of
our animals.

Clark Safari is home to 4,000 animals from 90 different species. This
includes a variety of mammals, birds, reptiles, and more. Visitors can see a
wide range of animals
Student Discount? Unfortunately, we currently do not offer student discounts at this time.

Yes, we are affiliated with Klook for online bookings. You can conveniently

At the moment, we do not provide overnight accommodations or staycation
packages. However, you are welcome to enjoy our attractions during regular
operating hours.

Yes, we have lounge areas and cabanas available where guests can relax
and enjoy their visit.
What resort nearby on your place?
If you're looking for a nearby resort, Aqua Planet is a popular option. It's a
large waterpark offering exciting attractions and a fun experience for guests
of all ages.

We sincerely apologize if you experienced any unpleasant service. May we

The entrance fee includes access to all attractions and sightseeing areas.
